# Igris 2.0.4

- New consistent violet-and-silver Igris icons for Windows and Android.
- Spoken briefings use a conversational factual summary; Updates includes a real notification-test button.
- Wellvell Interviews now renders schedule cards and shows the returned time period and empty states. The separate Clients tab is removed; Quotes represents client enquiries.
- Windows identifies its modes as Igris ? Workspace and Igris ? Overlay. The connected workspace remains a normal movable, resizable, minimizable desktop window.
- Android debug source includes ringing briefing alarms, native Accept/Decline controls, optional full-screen access and a Test briefing call action. Accept opens the live conversation without a second Answer tap; invitations expire after 45 seconds. Android recent-apps previews are restored.

Android release signing and physical acceptance of the new ringtone/locked-screen behavior remain pending. Android's permissions, notification channels and DND settings determine alert behavior. QStash, Core recovery, local schedules, provider budgets/cooldowns, rich notes and existing synced workspace features remain available. Durable cloud attachment transfer remains deferred.
